headline: Glittek Granites Q2FY27 Results & Land Buy
summary: Glittek Granites posts Q2FY27 net profit of ₹5.29 lakh, swinging from a loss. Board approves ₹6.50 crore land acquisition in Gujarat for business expansion.

headline: BRNL CS Ankita Rathi resigns
summary: Bharat Road Network Ltd announced the resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Ankita Rathi effective October 29, 2026, to pursue external career opportunities.

headline: IndiGo Q2 Results: Net loss narrows, revenue jumps
summary: IndiGo reported a Q2 net loss of ₹20.5b rupees, narrowing from ₹26.14b YoY. Revenue rose to ₹233.6b rupees from ₹185.55b, while EBITDA improved to ₹17.9b rupees with margin expanding to 7.67%.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Sanofi, MTAR, Bliss GVS in focus
summary: Sanofi rallies 6.6% on dividend news, while MTAR jumps 2.6% after massive profit surge. Check other movers.

headline: Qgo Finance allots ₹1 crore unsecured NCDs
summary: Qgo Finance Limited allotted 100 unsecured NCDs worth ₹1 crore at 12% interest. The 9-year tenure debentures were issued via private placement.

headline: Patel Retail expands Ambernath DC by 20k sq ft
summary: Patel Retail plans to add 20,000 sq ft to its fully utilized Ambernath distribution centre for ₹2 crore. The expansion aims to support store growth and inventory efficiency.

headline: Hikal Bengaluru API facility gets Swissmedic GMP cert
summary: Hikal's Bengaluru API facility received Swissmedic GMP certification, strengthening global regulatory standing and expanding access to European markets.

headline: Lord's Mark expands Brahmastra defence tech globally
summary: Lord's Mark Industries targets global markets with indigenous defence products BRAK RT, BRAK Alpha, and TRC-1, aiming to leverage India's growing EO/IR sector.

headline: ACME Solar signs 400 MW PPA with NTPC
summary: ACME Solar Holdings signs a 400 MW FDRE PPA with NTPC at ₹4.37/unit. The project integrates storage for dispatchable power, boosting its contracted portfolio.

headline: GPCB temporarily lifts closure order on Waaree plant
summary: Gujarat's GPCB has temporarily lifted a closure order on Waaree Energies' solar cell plant, allowing operations to resume under regulatory oversight.

headline: Sun Pharma's Ilumya gets USFDA nod for psoriatic arthritis
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries' Ilumya, an IL-23 inhibitor, has received USFDA approval for active psoriatic arthritis, expanding its biologics portfolio beyond psoriasis.

headline: Sagility sees ₹2,159 crore block trade on NSE
summary: Sagility India Limited witnessed a massive block trade of ₹2,159.03 crore involving over 50 crore shares at ₹42.80. Multiple smaller blocks also traded near ₹42.86.

headline: Blue Star sets EMPS EBIT margin guidance
summary: Blue Star has provided EBIT margin guidance of 7-7.5% for FY27 for its Electromechanical Projects and Services segment. The company expects upcoming quarterly profits to improve due to price hikes.

headline: Manipal Health promoter releases pledge on 2.38 cr shares
summary: MEMG International India Private Limited released pledges on 2.38 crore shares of Manipal Health Enterprises Ltd, reducing encumbered holdings to 1.44 crore shares.

headline: Welspun Corp maintains US EBITDA guidance
summary: Welspun Corp maintains its US EBITDA per tonne guidance at $250, citing uncertain geopolitical conditions as a reason for caution in the current market environment.

headline: Escorts Kubota plans tractor price hike from November 2026
summary: Escorts Kubota plans to raise tractor prices across all brands starting November 2026, citing inflation and geopolitical issues. Price changes will vary by model and location.

headline: Tega Industries promoter group shifts shares via gift
summary: Tega Industries Ltd filed SAST disclosures regarding an indirect acquisition of 46 shares in promoter entity NFSPL via a gift to Mehul Mohanka Benefit Trust, with no change in control.

headline: Altius Buildcon sells 5 shares of Shekhawati Industries
summary: Altius Buildcon Private Limited, part of the Ruia promoter group, sold 5 equity shares of Shekhawati Industries Limited on October 27, 2026. The group's total holding remains at 65.55%.

headline: Nusli Wadia sells 12.81 lakh BBTC shares
summary: Promoter Nusli N. Wadia sold 12,81,356 shares of Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation via inter-se transfer on October 29, 2026, reducing his stake to 0.01%.

headline: SBICAP Trustee releases pledge on Ginni Filaments shares
summary: SBICAP Trustee Company Limited released 26.48 lakh equity shares of Ginni Filaments, reducing its holding to 9.06%. The release was executed on October 29, 2026.

headline: Jio Financial allots 25 crore shares
summary: Jio Financial Services allotted 25 crore equity shares upon warrant conversion at ₹306.50 per share, raising promoter group stake.

headline: Jalan family raises stake in Tandhan Energies
summary: Anuj Jalan and Persons Acting in Concert increased their combined holding in Tandhan Energies Limited to 69.39% through an off-market purchase of 2.92 lakh shares.

headline: Menon Bearings targets 8-10% EV revenue by FY27
summary: Menon Bearings plans for the EV segment to contribute 8-10% of business by FY27. The company also aims to increase exports to 37% of revenue, up from 34% currently.

headline: Nishad Shah group acquires 16.98% stake in RGF Capital
summary: Nishad J. Shah and associated entities acquired 2.54 crore equity shares of RGF Capital Markets Ltd on Oct 27, 2026. The combined holding now stands at 30.89%.

headline: Menon Bearings eyes Africa expansion, new revenue line
summary: Menon Bearings plans to expand into Africa through a distributor network. New components are expected to generate ₹55 crore in annual revenue.

headline: Network18 Q2 net profit rises to ₹52 crore
summary: Network18 Media & Investments reported a consolidated net profit of ₹52 crore for Q2, up from ₹40.7 crore YoY. Revenue rose to ₹540 crore, while EBITDA turned positive at ₹18.6 crore.

headline: Mastek appoints Niraj Khemka as VP Finance
summary: Mastek Limited has appointed Niraj Khemka as Vice President – Finance. He will also lead the company's Investor Relations function, effective October 30, 2026.

headline: Natco Pharma promoter group buys shares via rights issue
summary: Natco Pharma's promoter group acquired equity shares through rights issue allotment. Venkaiah Chowdary Nannapaneni's holding rose to 14.60%, with total group stake increasing significantly.

headline: Smartworks Q2 EBITDA jumps to ₹3.8B
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd reported Q2 revenue of ₹5.9 billion, up from ₹4.25 billion YoY. EBITDA rose to ₹3.8 billion with margins holding steady at 63.85%.

headline: Wordexx sells 5.85 lakh MRC Agrotech shares
summary: Wordexx Ventures sold 5,84,823 equity shares of MRC Agrotech Ltd via open market, reducing its stake from 10.62% to 8.75% between September and October 2026.

headline: SP Capital Financing sets Nov 13 record date
summary: SP Capital Financing Ltd has fixed November 13, 2026 as the record date for its interim dividend for FY27. Shareholders registered by this date will be eligible.

headline: Amanta Healthcare COO resigns
summary: Amanta Healthcare Ltd announced the resignation of Chief Operating Officer Anil Rathi, effective October 29, 2026, citing better opportunities.

headline: Akme Fintrade gets trading approval for 82 lakh shares
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Ltd received trading approval from NSE and BSE for 82,00,000 equity shares allotted via warrant conversion. Listed capital rises to ₹44.79 crore.

headline: Religare appoints Dipti Khandelwal as CS
summary: Religare Enterprises appointed Ms. Dipti Jayesh Khandelwal as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 31, 2026. She brings 20 years of experience in corporate law and capital markets.

headline: CarTrade Tech Consumer Group revenue hits ₹308 crore
summary: CarTrade Tech reported H1FY27 consumer group revenue of ₹157.6 crore, up 10% YoY. The segment achieved a 27% CAGR over five years, reaching ₹308.3 crore in FY26.

headline: Suzlon Q2FY27 profit falls 69% YoY
summary: Suzlon Energy reported a net profit of ₹394.15 crore for Q2FY27, down 69% YoY, despite revenue rising 26%. Welspun Corp posted strong growth.

headline: Shardul Securities promoter stake rises post-buyback
summary: Shardul Securities promoters' holding increased to 72.56% after buyback acceptance, despite Shriyam Commodities selling shares.

headline: ICICI Prudential MF cuts Sona BLW stake below 6%
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund sold 1.22 crore Sona BLW shares, reducing its holding to 5.05% from 7.06%. The net sale occurred between August 2025 and October 2026.

headline: Smartworks raises FY27 revenue growth forecast
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces has revised its FY27 revenue growth forecast upward to 33-35%, compared to its earlier guidance of 28-30%, signalling stronger business momentum.

headline: Mugi Constructions acquires 5.28% in DCM Shriram Industries
summary: Mugi Constructions Pvt. Ltd. and related entities crossed the 5% threshold in DCM Shriram Industries via open market purchases, holding 45.94 lakh shares.

headline: Silver Pearl board meeting moved to Nov 14
summary: Silver Pearl Hospitality & Luxury Spaces Ltd rescheduled its board meeting to November 14, 2026, to approve H1FY27 results due to auditor unavailability.

headline: Carver Roboweld IPO Day 3 Update
summary: Carver Roboweld IPO subscribed 2.76x on final day. NII leads demand at 8.19x; Retail at 2.65x. QIB participation remains nil.

headline: Ajwa Projects IPO crosses 1x on Day 3
summary: Ajwa Projects IPO crossed the fully subscribed mark on Day 3, reaching 1.03x overall. Retail led at 1.76x while QIB and bHNI categories remained muted at 0x and 0.08x respectively.

headline: Bombay Coated Steels IPO 3.09x on Day 2
summary: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO subscribed 3.09x by Day 2. QIB demand leads at 6.55x, while Retail bids hit 1.95x. Issue closes Nov 2.

headline: Antala IPO Day 2: QIBs Lead Demand
summary: Antala Industries IPO sees strong institutional interest with QIBs subscribed 66.72x. Retail demand remains sluggish at 0.08x, keeping overall subscription at 0.84x.

headline: Maxwell Engg IPO Day 1: Retail leads demand
summary: Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO subscribed 1.13x on Day 1. Retail investors drove interest with 1.91x subscription, while QIBs remained at 0x.

headline: Vectras Enprocon IPO Day 1: Subscribed 0.14x
summary: Vectras Enprocon IPO sees muted demand on Day 1 with overall subscription at 0.14x. Retail leads at 0.2x while QIB interest remains at zero.

headline: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO Day 3 Update
summary: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO subscribed 1.95x on Day 3. NII demand leads with bHNI at 4.89x. QIB at 0.99x, Retail at 1.45x.

headline: HGS IPO Day 1: Retail at 0.06x, NII leads
summary: HGS IPO opened on 30 Oct 2026 with total subscription at 0.06x on Day 1. Retail investors subscribed 0.06x while bHNI led NII at 0.17x. QIB participation remains nil.
